data.long_description:
Luxurious 5-bedroom villa in the prestigious The Acres community, Phase 2.

Experience elevated luxury living in this stunning 5-bedroom villa located in The Acres Phase 2, a premium nature-inspired community in Dubai Land. Spanning a generous 8,317.7 sq ft, this contemporary home offers expansive space, refined finishes, and exceptional privacy—perfect for families seeking comfort and exclusivity.

The villa boasts a bright open-plan living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows that overlook the private garden and outdoor areas. The modern kitchen features high-quality fittings, ample countertop space, and elegant cabinetry, making it ideal for both daily use and entertaining.

Each of the five spacious bedrooms is thoughtfully designed with built-in wardrobes and en-suite or attached bathrooms. The master suite offers a luxurious retreat, complete with a walk-in closet, premium en-suite bathroom, and serene views.

Located within The Acres, residents enjoy a peaceful environment surrounded by greenery, lakes, parks, and first-class community amenities.

Property Features:

-BUA: 7,396 SQ FT
-Plot: 8,317 SQ FT
-Facing: Green Belt
-5 bedrooms + 7 bathrooms
-Sunlit open-plan living & dining areas
-High-end contemporary interior finishes
-Large windows with abundant natural light
-All bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
-Master suite with walk-in closet & luxury en-suite
-Multiple terraces & landscaped outdoor areas
-Maid’s room + storage + utility

Community Amenities – The Acres (Phase 2)

-Gated and secure family-friendly community
-Lush parks, landscaped gardens & green corridors

Easy access to major highways and city destinations
